entries.1e826c365e93c413: The company positions this as an environment in which both the intensifying competition for cases caused by the increase in lawyers and the high level of demand for legal consultations push up demand for client-acquisition support from field-specialized media. There is no description of the company's ranking or market share.
entries.2a43bb9ce8a700b3: Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥6,647 million.
entries.2cd22946d6dbfe36: Its main customers are lawyers, law firms, and companies that place advertisements. In recruitment, customers are law firms and companies that hire personnel, and in insurance, the policyholders are small and medium-sized enterprises, sole proprietors, and individuals.
entries.2f1c8f6b4257a187: This business consists of Legal Media, which operates field-specialized legal media mainly serving lawyers, and Derivative Media, which serves advertisers other than lawyers.
entries.36fd294a236e388b: This business consists of Legal Media, which operates field-specialized legal media mainly serving lawyers, and Derivative Media, which serves advertisers other than lawyers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥6,242 million. The company had 127 consolidated employees as of October 31, 2025, and 1 consolidated subsidiary.
entries.3710dd52aa7147c8: Based on the features and revenue structure of the legal media described in Business Overview, and the background to the launch of the HR and Insurance Businesses
entries.390b7880c86d45fa: This business operates separate “Bennabi” sites for each of 8 case fields (divorce, traffic accidents, inheritance, labor issues, criminal cases, debt collection, debt consolidation and IT) and publishes advertisements for individual lawyers or law corporations. Under a stock-type revenue model that earns advertising income by multiplying the number of listing slots by the monthly flat-rate unit price per slot, revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥3,784 million.
entries.4f388dfa77f12186: In the legal profession, its main customer base, the number of lawyers continued to increase, reaching 45,808 as of March 2024, and the number of legal consultations at bar associations and similar bodies has remained at a high level, at approximately 583,000 in fiscal 2023. Accordingly, while competition for new clients among law firms intensifies with the increase in lawyers, the need for efficient client acquisition using the internet continues to rise structurally, and the company states that the market opportunity for the lawyer-matching platform it operates continues to expand.
entries.57950369436f1788: Insurance premium income from attorney fee insurance
entries.5798e0526ca85635: A company that operates, centered on the legal media for lawyers "Benavi", spin-off media, recruitment placement services and small-amount short-term insurance.
entries.59bc1aff8e624f11: This business provides placement services for personnel such as licensed lawyers, certified public accountants, tax accountants and corporate administration staff, and operates job sites such as “NO-LIMIT,” which specializes in lawyers, “Hi-Standard,” which specializes in certified public accountants and tax accountants, and “BEET AGENT,” which specializes in corporate administration staff, among others. Under a performance-based model that earns placement fees from hiring companies when a candidate is hired and joins the company, revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥335 million.
entries.6600f992a9bb7554: This business operates separate “Bennabi” sites for each of 8 case fields (divorce, traffic accidents, inheritance, labor issues, criminal cases, debt collection, debt consolidation and IT) and publishes advertisements for individual lawyers or law corporations.
entries.7a44816600cac25a: The company operates mainly in the “Media Business,” running legal media aimed at lawyers and derivative media aimed at customers other than lawyers. It intends to continue expanding this business and to pursue further growth through active development of new businesses that leverage its management resources, such as the “HR Business” and the “Insurance Business.”
entries.7ab346434f940c25: This business is conducted by consolidated subsidiary ASIRO Small-Amount Short-Term Insurance Inc. (ownership of voting rights 78.87%), which operates a small-amount short-term insurance business. It sells attorney fee insurance, which pays part of the costs incurred when a lawyer is engaged to resolve everyday-life troubles, and has stopped new sales promotion for individual products; it is concentrating its management resources on the attorney fee insurance “bonobo” for corporations and sole proprietors, which began sales in July 2025. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥69 million.

entries.cd7542d2d94f6a83: The legal media consist mainly of individual Bennabi sites, each specialized by the case fields that lawyers handle. Lawyers can readily receive inquiries in the case fields they actively want to take on, and users can consult lawyers who actively handle the case field they are facing. The company states that a major feature is that mismatches are unlikely to occur.
entries.d388fbcec52b40cd: This business operates media sites such as “Kyarizumu,” which serves job placement agencies, and “Uwaki Chōsa Navi” and “Hitosagashi no Madoguchi,” which serve detective agencies, among others. Users use the sites free of charge, and the business earns performance-based fees from advertising clients according to the number of inquiries from users, under a flow-type revenue model; revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥2,458 million.
entries.df475ff4ff65e549: Its business model centers on legal media that earn advertising revenue from advertisers such as lawyers, and earns revenue from referral fees for licensed-profession and back-office personnel and from insurance premiums for attorney fee insurance.

entries.f067cdf4d309fde4: In the Media Business, the company plans to diversify its revenue base by expanding listing slots and customer numbers, developing small and mid-sized law firms, and diversifying its product lineup. In the HR Business, it is expanding recruitment targets to licensed-profession and back-office personnel. In the Insurance Business, it is focusing on promoting attorney fee insurance for corporations, “bonobo.”
